📖 How to use

  1. Enter the home price and your planned down payment.
  2. Set the annual interest rate and the loan term in years.
  3. Read your monthly payment, total interest and total cost instantly.
  4. Scroll the yearly amortization table to see how each year's principal and interest split changes over time.

❓ Frequently asked questions

Does this include property taxes and insurance?

No. This calculates principal and interest (P&I) only. Property taxes, homeowner's insurance and PMI must be added separately to get the full monthly cost.

How is the monthly payment calculated?

With the standard amortizing-loan formula M = P * r(1+r)^n / ((1+r)^n - 1), where r is the monthly interest rate and n is the total number of monthly payments.

What does the amortization schedule assume?

The schedule assumes fixed on-time payments for the whole term. Extra principal payments would shorten the loan and reduce total interest, but they are not modeled here.
